description.zh: 在百度网盘和素材库之间搬文件。拉:用 pan_list 或 pan_search 找到 fs_id,再用 pan_import 导进来。传:用 pan_upload 把素材库里的东西存到网盘(传 asset_id 和目标路径)。
description.en: Move files between Baidu Netdisk and the asset library. To pull: find an fs_id with pan_list or pan_search, then bring it in with pan_import. To push: use pan_upload to save something from the asset library to the netdisk (pass an asset_id and a target path).

description.zh: 列出百度网盘某个目录下的文件和子目录。返回每一项的 fs_id、文件名、大小、是不是目录。fs_id 是后面 pan_import 要用的。一次最多 limit 条,还有没列出的时 has_more 为真,把 next_start 传回 start 接着列。
description.en: List the files and sub-directories under a Baidu Netdisk directory. Each entry carries its fs_id, name, size and whether it is a directory. The fs_id is what pan_import takes. At most limit entries per call; when has_more is true, pass next_start back as start to continue.

description.zh: 按文件名在百度网盘里搜索。找不准路径时用这个,比一层层 pan_list 快。返回同样带 fs_id;命中比 limit 多时 has_more 为真 —— 换个更准的关键词或限定目录。
description.en: Search Baidu Netdisk by file name. Use this when you don't know the exact path — it beats walking down with pan_list. Results carry fs_id the same way; has_more is true when there were more hits than limit — use a sharper keyword or narrow the directory.

description.zh: 把百度网盘里的一个文件拉进素材库。传 pan_list / pan_search 给出的 fs_id。返回 asset_id,之后就和别的素材一样用。
description.en: Pull one file from Baidu Netdisk into the asset library. Pass an fs_id from pan_list or pan_search. Returns an asset_id you can use like any other asset.

description.zh: 把素材库里的一个文件传到百度网盘。传 asset_id 和网盘上的目标路径(如 /我的资源/成片.mp4)。边传边报进度,最长 30 分钟。
description.en: Send one file from the asset library to Baidu Netdisk. Pass an asset_id and the target path on the netdisk (e.g. /My files/final.mp4). Reports progress as it goes; up to 30 minutes.

description.zh: 使用你选择的智能体操作本机 Blender：查询场景、编辑模型和材质。3D 工作台可发送场景与镜头，接收加工结果并保留 .blend 工程。需安装配套 Blender MCP 2.0.3 Add-on。
description.en: Use your chosen agent to inspect and edit local Blender models and materials. Send scenes and cameras from the 3D studio, receive edited models, and keep .blend projects. Requires the matching Blender MCP 2.0.3 add-on.

description.zh: 把一台 ComfyUI(本机或局域网)接进 Mosael:它保存的每张工作流既是一个图像 / 视频生成模型,也是一个工具(「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是那张图自己的提示词、读素材的节点和可调参数,交回全部产出)。另有列出工作流与模型文件、看显卡和队列、把历史产出收进素材库、中断 / 清队列 / 释放显存。
description.en: Connect a ComfyUI server (local or on your LAN): every saved workflow is both an image / video generation model and a tool (“Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that graph's own prompts, loader nodes and tunable parameters, returning every output). Plus listing workflows and model files, GPU and queue status, importing past outputs into the asset library, and interrupt / clear queue / free VRAM.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 在这台 ComfyUI 上列出模型与工具(每张工作流一个)、做一次生成。只给宿主调。
description.en: Lists models and tools (one per workflow) and runs generations on this ComfyUI server for Mosael. Host-only.

description.zh: 这台 ComfyUI 上保存的每张工作流:能喂什么(图 / 蒙版 / 视频 / 音频各接在哪个节点)、能调什么、会交出什么、看起来在做什么(放大、局部重绘、抠图…)。先用它挑一张,再用 run_workflow 跑。
description.en: Every workflow saved on this ComfyUI: what it takes (which node loads each image / mask / video / audio), what can be tuned, what it outputs, and what it seems to do (upscale, inpaint, background removal…). Pick one here, then run it with run_workflow.

description.zh: 给智能体的退路:按 id 原样跑任意一张工作流,输入用通用的几个参数(`image` / `images` / `mask` / `video` / `audio`,`values` 改任意节点的值)。**每张工作流都有自己的工具**(「工作流 · 名字」,入参就是它自己的节点),优先用那个;这个工具的长处是 `wait: false` 只提交、之后用 import_outputs 取回。
description.en: An escape hatch for the agent: run any workflow by id with generic inputs (`image` / `images` / `mask` / `video` / `audio`, `values` for any node). **Every workflow has its own tool** (“Workflow · name”, whose inputs are that workflow's own nodes) — prefer it; this one is for `wait: false` submit-now, fetch-later with import_outputs.

description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 历史里的产出收进素材库:给任务号就取那一个(还在跑可以等一会儿),不给就取最近几次。在 ComfyUI 界面里跑出来的东西也能这样拿回来。
description.en: Imports outputs from ComfyUI's history into the asset library: a task id fetches that one (optionally waiting while it runs), otherwise the most recent runs. Also works for things run directly in the ComfyUI interface.

description.zh: ComfyUI 的版本、显卡与空闲显存、内存,以及队列里在跑 / 排队的任务数。
description.en: ComfyUI version, GPU and free VRAM, RAM, and how many tasks are running / queued.

description.zh: 服务器上装了哪些模型文件,按目录分:checkpoints、loras、vae、upscale_models、controlnet、diffusion_models…
description.en: Model files installed on the server by folder: checkpoints, loras, vae, upscale_models, controlnet, diffusion_models…

description.zh: 停下 ComfyUI 正在跑的任务。给了任务号就只停那一个(在跑的中断,排队的删掉),不会误伤别人的任务。
description.en: Stops the task ComfyUI is running. With a task id only that one is stopped (interrupted if running, removed if queued), leaving other people's tasks alone.

description.zh: 清掉 ComfyUI 里所有**排队中**的任务(在跑的不动)。同一台服务器上别人排的任务也会被清掉。
description.en: Clears every **queued** task in ComfyUI (the running one is untouched). Tasks queued by other people on the same server are cleared too.

description.zh: 让 ComfyUI 卸载模型、释放显存。下一次生成要重新加载模型,会慢一些。
description.en: Asks ComfyUI to unload models and free VRAM. The next run reloads its models and is slower.

description.zh: 用 Manim(3Blue1Brown 那套数学动画的社区版)做教学动画,本机渲染、零生成费用:公式推导、几何关系、函数图像、算法步骤、代码讲解、物理示意。要「一步一步地变」而且必须讲对的内容用它;要真实画面(人物、场景、实拍感)用视频生成模型;要排版精致的图文讲解卡片、数据图表也可以用 Remotion 插件。给结构化内容(每一步的标题、旁白、要点、公式 / 函数图 / 代码)就出讲解视频,不用写代码;更自由的画面写一段 Manim 场景代码(默认不开放,要在插件页勾选)。第一次用前在插件页运行「准备 Manim 环境」。Manim 是 MIT 许可。
description.en: Teaching animations with Manim (the community edition of 3Blue1Brown's maths animation engine), rendered on this computer at no generation cost: derivations, geometry, function plots, algorithm steps, code walk-throughs, physics diagrams. Use it for content that must change step by step and be correct; use a video generation model for realistic footage; the Remotion plugin also suits polished text-and-chart explainer cards. Structured content (each step's title, narration, points and a formula / plot / code) becomes an explainer with no code; anything freer is a Manim scene in Python (off by default — enable it on the plugins page). Run "Prepare Manim" once on the plugins page first. Manim is MIT-licensed.

description.zh: 在插件自己的数据目录里建 Python 环境、装锁定版本的 Manim,查 LaTeX,试渲一帧;缺什么(macOS 的 cairo、Linux 的开发包、LaTeX)逐条说怎么装。第一次要一到几分钟,之后几乎瞬间完成。渲染工具不会顺手装环境,第一次请先跑它。
description.en: Creates a Python environment in the plugin's data directory, installs the pinned Manim, checks LaTeX and renders a test frame; anything missing (cairo on macOS, dev packages on Linux, LaTeX) comes back with how to install it. The first run takes a few minutes; later runs are near-instant. The render tools do not install anything, so run this first.

description.zh: 给结构化的教学内容,出一段 Manim 讲解视频(mp4,进素材库),不用写代码:标题页 → 一步一步讲(每步:标题、旁白字幕、逐条出现的要点,再配一样:LaTeX 公式、函数图像或逐处高亮的代码)→ 要点回顾。每步多长按旁白的朗读时长自动算;返回每一步的实际起止时间(steps),可选同时出 .srt 字幕,方便配音对时间。本机没装 LaTeX 时公式写成一行纯文字,照样出片。默认 720p,智能体调用时别选 production / 4k。
description.en: Turns structured teaching content into a Manim explainer video (mp4, into the asset library), no code needed: a title card, then steps (each with a title, narration captions, points revealed one by one, plus one visual: LaTeX formulas, a function plot or code highlighted stop by stop), then key takeaways. Step length follows the narration's reading time; returns each step's actual start and end (steps) and optionally an .srt file to sync a voice-over. Without LaTeX on this computer formulas are shown as plain text. 720p by default; avoid production / 4k when called by the agent.

description.zh: 用一段 Manim(社区版 0.21)场景代码渲染动画(进素材库)。代码里定义 `class 名字(Scene)`,在 `construct(self)` 里 `self.play(...)`;`from manim import *` 即可,调用时给的 data 用 `from mosael import DATA` 读。默认只准 import manim、math、numpy 等画图模块,不准读写文件、起进程。报错会指出是第几行哪句代码,改了再调。**会在本机执行 Python 代码**,默认不开放。讲解类内容优先用「Manim 讲解视频」。
description.en: Renders a Manim (Community 0.21) scene from Python code (into the asset library). Define `class Name(Scene)` and `self.play(...)` in `construct(self)`; `from manim import *` is enough, and the data given here is `from mosael import DATA`. By default only drawing modules (manim, math, numpy …) may be imported and files or processes are off limits. Errors point at the line and code, so fix and call again. **Runs Python code on this computer**; off by default. Prefer the explainer tool for lesson-style content.

description.zh: 和「Manim 自定义动画」同样给一段场景代码,只要最后一帧(PNG,进素材库):几何图、函数图、示意图、封面。可以透明背景。同样会在本机执行代码,默认不开放。
description.en: Same scene code as the custom animation tool, but only the last frame (PNG, into the asset library): diagrams, plots, covers. Supports a transparent background. Also runs code on this computer; off by default.

description.zh: 把素材库里的文件传到你的对象存储(阿里云 OSS / 腾讯云 COS / 火山引擎 TOS / Amazon S3 / S3 兼容服务),换回一条**公网直链** —— 有些供应商只收链接不收本地文件(方舟 Seedance 的参考视频就是一例)。也能列出桶里的对象、给已有对象签直链、把对象拉回素材库。
description.en: Upload assets to your object storage (Alibaba Cloud OSS / Tencent Cloud COS / Volcengine TOS / Amazon S3 / any S3-compatible service) and get a public link back — some providers only accept a URL, not a local file (Seedance's reference video is one). Also lists a bucket, signs links for existing objects and pulls objects back into the library.

description.zh: 把一份素材传上去,交回一条**限时直链**(签名在查询串里,桶不必设成公共读)。这就是「本地文件怎么变成公网链接」的答案 —— 直接粘进生成节点的参考视频那一格。大文件分片上传,边传边报进度。
description.en: Upload an asset and hand back a time-limited direct link (the signature lives in the query string, so the bucket need not be public-read). This is how a local file becomes a URL. Large files go up in parts, with progress.

description.zh: 给桶里已有的对象签一条限时直链。
description.en: Sign a time-limited direct link for an object already in the bucket.

description.zh: 把桶里的一个对象拉回素材库。**交回的是地址,由宿主搬字节** —— 进度、取消、重试都归它。
description.en: Pull an object back into the asset library. The plugin hands over a URL and the host moves the bytes — progress, cancel and retry all come for free.

description.zh: 列出桶里某个前缀下的对象(路径、大小、修改时间)。一页最多 1000 条,还有下一页时交回 next_cursor。
description.en: List objects under a prefix (key, size, last modified). Up to 1000 per page; next_cursor is returned when there is more.

description.zh: 用代码做动画视频,零生成费用:知识点讲解、公式推导、代码演示、数据图表。要讲准确的东西(文字、公式、步骤、数字)用它;要真实画面(人物、场景、实拍感)用视频生成模型。讲解视频给内容就能出片;更自由的画面写一段 Remotion 组件代码。需要本机装有 Node.js 18+。Remotion 对个人与 3 人以内的公司免费,更大的公司需要购买 Remotion 公司许可。
description.en: Make animated videos with code, at no generation cost: lesson explainers, formula walk-throughs, code demos, data charts. Use it when accuracy matters (text, formulas, steps, numbers); use a video generation model for realistic footage. Explainers need only content; anything freer is a short Remotion component. Needs Node.js 18+ on this computer. Remotion is free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people; larger companies need a Remotion company license.

description.zh: 安装 Remotion 与渲染用的浏览器。第一次要几十秒到几分钟,之后几乎是瞬间完成。渲染工具不会顺手装环境(装到一半被预算掐掉只会留下半截),第一次请先在插件页跑它;插件升级换了 Remotion 版本、Node.js 换了架构时,渲染工具会提醒再跑一次。
description.en: Install Remotion and the rendering browser. The first run takes from tens of seconds to a few minutes; after that it is near-instant. The render tools do not install anything (a half-finished install cut off by their budget only leaves a broken one), so run this first from the plugin page; the render tools say when to run it again (a new Remotion version, a Node.js with another architecture).

description.zh: 给内容,出一段知识点讲解视频(mp4,进素材库):标题 → 一节一节讲(小标题、逐条出现的要点、KaTeX 公式、逐行出现的代码、提示)→ 要点回顾。每段多长按内容算,不用给时间轴。讲数学、物理、编程、概念解释、操作步骤都合适。
description.en: Turn content into a lesson explainer video (mp4, into the asset library): a title, then sections (heading, points that appear one by one, a KaTeX formula, code that appears line by line, a note), then key takeaways. Timing follows the content; no timeline needed. Good for maths, physics, programming, concepts and how-tos.

description.zh: 用一段 Remotion 组件代码渲染动画(mp4,进素材库)。代码是一个 TSX 模块,`export default` 一个组件,它收到 `{ data }`(即这里传的 data);用 useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence(都从 'remotion' 导入)做动画。只能 import react、remotion、katex。报错会原样返回,改了再调即可。讲解类内容优先用「讲解视频」。
description.en: Render an animation from a Remotion component (mp4, into the asset library). The code is a TSX module that `export default`s a component receiving `{ data }` (the data given here); animate with useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence from 'remotion'. Only react, remotion and katex can be imported. Errors come back verbatim, so fix and call again. Prefer the explainer tool for lesson-style content.

description.zh: 文本小工具:统计字数、词数与念完要多久,提取 #话题# 与 #hashtag 标签。纯本地计算,无需任何权限。
description.en: Small text utilities: count characters and words, estimate read-aloud time, and pull out #topic# and #hashtag tags. All local, no permissions needed.

description.zh: 统计文本的字数、词数与预计口播时长(中文每秒约 4.5 字,英文每分钟约 150 词)。中日韩文一个字算一个词。
description.en: Count characters and words in a text and estimate read-aloud time (about 4.5 Chinese characters a second, 150 English words a minute). Each CJK character counts as a word.

description.zh: 从文案中提取 #话题# 与 #hashtag 标签,按出现的先后;大小写不同的算同一个,纯数字的(#1)不算。
description.en: Pull #topic# and #hashtag tags out of a piece of copy, in order of appearance; case-insensitive duplicates and all-digit tags (#1) are skipped.

description.zh: 读抖音 / TikTok / 小红书 / B站 / 快手等平台的公开数据:作品详情、作者主页与作品列表、关键词搜索、热榜。用于选题调研、对标账号分析、找素材灵感。
description.en: Read public data from Douyin / TikTok / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili / Kuaishou and other platforms: post details, creator profiles and their posts, keyword search, trending charts. For topic research, studying comparable accounts, and finding footage ideas.
